items.title: Mrs. Cozzy Cary Interview, 1961-08-09
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Abramica was singing one for you yesterday...

ctx.x: Yeah, I remember, oh yes, I tell you, I don't, I most forgot all of them When I was a little child, you know, ring-around to them I don't forget them I can't think of one of them now I don't forget them
The Beaver was singing one for you the other day Abramica was singing one for you yesterday I don't know How about, any songs about King Jesus?
